name: Solar Open 2
short: Upstage's 250B-A15B open-weight MoE built for agents — Korea's sovereign foundation model. 1M context via hybrid attention (linear attention on 75% of 48 layers, NoPE); LiveCodeBench v6 92.4%, SWE-bench Verified 70.4%, Ko-GDPval 86.8. Runs on two H200s quantized.
modalities: Text in/out (Korean, English, Japanese officially supported)
pricingNote: Open weights under the Upstage Solar License (commercial use, fine-tuning and distillation permitted); self-host on 4x H200 BF16 or 2x H200 quantized — no published per-token price
